name: Gertie Bladeshield
source: Gertie Bladeshield was Kristen's rebound. Kristen left her heartbroken, so Gertie declared Kristen her nemesis. Enough said. Maybe Kristen can make amends at the Apiarists' Society after school, but that might not be the safest option.
